fields.rt-blog-html:
From June 11 to July 19, 2026, the World Cup will be held in North America, attracting billions of television viewers. For fast food professionals, this event represents a real business opportunity.

To really boost your fast-food sales during the World Cup, anticipation and operational optimization will make all the difference.

‍

Why is the 2026 World Cup a major opportunity for your fast-food restaurant?

Major sporting events change consumer habits. Customers cook less, socialize more, and favor quick solutions so they can enjoy the game.

According to an analysis published in Artisans Gourmands, fast food restaurants are demonstrating a strong ability to adapt despite cost pressures. Consumers remain budget-conscious, but continue to favor affordable, fast, and convenient options. 

The economic impact of major sporting events on fast food

During major competitions, consumption revolves around volume, speed, and sharing. Group orders naturally increase the average basket size, particularly for combo meals, beverages, and additional products.

Consumer profiles and behaviors during games

The customer base changes during sporting events. There is an increase in orders from men, but also a strong family presence. Soccer remains the most popular sport in France, which broadens the target audience well beyond enthusiasts.

‍

How to prepare your offer and maximize your sales during the World Cup?

Structuring your strategy in advance allows you to turn a peak in activity into increased profitability.

Design your event menu and optimize your pricing strategy

The challenge is not to add a single product, but to build a coherent offering, such as a special World Cup menu.

Focus on shareable formats, menus for two or four people, and limited editions. Encourage additional sales: large drinks or desserts to share. By guiding choices without complicating the menu, you increase the average ticket value.

👉 To go further: Fast food: 20 trends to watch in 2026.

Anticipate your inventory and secure your supplies

The World Cup lasts over a month. Stock shortages directly impact performance and customer experience. Analyze your data from similar events to estimate the volumes you'll need and secure your flagship products, beverages, and packaging in advance.

Careful planning allows for better control of these margins and limits waste.

Roll out promotional offers and adapt your sales formats

This period warrants occasional adjustments. Extending your hours during major games can capture additional traffic. 

You can also offer limited-time deals to create a sense of urgency.

What digital tools can be used to manage customer traffic and streamline orders?

Success depends on your ability to absorb a large amount of information in a short period of time.

Click & collect: anticipate orders and reduce waiting times

Advance ordering is a strategic tool. By encouraging your customers to reserve before kickoff, you can even out the workload in the kitchen and reduce wait times on site. 

Order terminals: speed up autonomous order taking

Order terminals streamline the ordering process and reduce pressure on front-of-house staff. 

With tools synchronized between online orders and the preparation system, you can optimize your efficiency.

👉 To go further: KDS and online orders: synchronization and real gains.

Fast payment solution to reduce queues

By integrating payment directly, you simplify the customer journey and speed up throughput during busy periods. This setup allows your teams to focus on production and quality.

“The kiosk allows me to free up a cashier, who can then focus on service and cooking.” Guillaume Coiffe, Smash Smash franchisee.

Mobile app and online ordering: capturing customers upstream

On game nights, delivery services experience peaks in activity. Highlight your offers on your online ordering site and partner platforms. Promote your shareable products and make navigation easier to encourage quick purchasing decisions.

👉 To go further: 5 tips for attracting more customers to your restaurant.

Real-time monitoring: track your performance during the event

A connected POS system allows you to track your sales in real time, analyze changes in average basket size, and identify your best sellers. This visibility helps you quickly adjust your inventory and promotions.

How to manage and optimize your business during and after the World Cup?

Performance depends as much on organization as it does on the offering.

Organize your teams for peak periods

Identify high-audience events and adapt your schedules accordingly. Temporary extra staff in the kitchen or dining room can prevent overcrowding and maintain service quality.

Adapt your communication and digital presence

Your establishment must be visible on social media, Google, and mobile devices. Activate geolocation-based campaigns to quickly generate traffic over a short period of time.

Boost engagement with features such as a prediction system for your loyal customers. Simple applications make them easy to set up and energize your local community.

👉 To go further: How to effectively promote your restaurant on TikTok.

‍

The 2026 World Cup represents a strategic opportunity for fast food restaurants. By structuring your offering, anticipating your volumes, digitizing the ordering process, and managing your business with precision, you can transform a temporary peak in demand into a sustainable driver of profitability.

Demand intensifies for a month. It's up to you to turn it into a controlled growth engine.

‍
